How to Choose Running Shoes

By Jamie Lee

The right running shoe matches your foot shape, your running surface and how far you run each week. Start with fit, then think about cushioning, and replace your shoes every 500 to 800 kilometres.

Why does fit matter?

About 70% of running injuries are linked to poor footwear, according to one study.

Signs of a good fit

  • A thumb's width of space at the toe
  • No slipping at the heel
